name: comp-133
title: Indeterminate Checkbox
blurb: Checkbox demonstrating the indeterminate state (shows dash instead of check).
description: Indeterminate checkbox example using shadcn Checkbox and Label. Starts in indeterminate state and toggles through unchecked, checked, and back.
use_when: Parent checkboxes in hierarchies where children have mixed selection states.
a11y: Checkbox and label properly associated. Keyboard navigation supported. Indeterminate state visual via SVG dash.
